claims.claim_text: Executive technology leader who directs alliance-led modernization and platform productization, aligning partner operating models with IP-led revenue growth, margin expansion, and resilient regulated delivery.
From that commercial base, IBM-AWS alliance co-sell motions connect financial-services modernization opportunities with joint go-to-market execution and hyperscaler partnership strategy.
Against that lineage backdrop, platform productization generated $22M in IP-led revenue alongside margin expansion, giving innovation investment a measurable enterprise operating stake.
In parallel, release automation and security scanning were embedded in regulated modernization delivery paths, integrating security into release-resilience operations.
That operating foundation also applied AI-driven sales frameworks and alliance co-sell cadence to 20% joint revenue growth, with joint-solution development anchoring partner execution.
The combined platform and partnership model can scale agentic platform productization and partner-led AI solutions while preserving release resilience for regulated modernization.
